display.purpose: Level-one document titles and major note boundaries.

headline.purpose: Level-two sections with the primary heading wash.

body.purpose: Long-form note content, lists, quotations, and tasks.

motion.name: task-confirm
motion.purpose: One size pulse when a task becomes checked.

motion.name: formatting-bar-visibility
motion.purpose: Reveal or hide the keyboard-adjacent formatting surface.

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: A bold heading with a restrained wash that follows the text width.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { position: relative; display: table; margin: 28px 0 7px; color: #000; font: 700 23px/1.18 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-section-heading::after { position: absolute; z-index: -1; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 9px; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(118,123,255,.30), rgba(189,124,255,0)); content: ""; }

components.name: Formatting Control
components.css: .ds-format-control { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #000; font: 400 24px/1 -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-format-control:hover, .ds-format-control:focus-visible { background: rgba(118,118,128,.08); outline: none; }

components.name: Selected Formatting Control
components.description: The active block style, marked by a quiet neutral fill.
components.css: .ds-format-control-selected { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(118,118,128,.12); color: #000; font: 400 24px/1 -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-format-control-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007aff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Open Task Item
components.description: An open task with a compact box inside a full touch target.
components.css: .ds-task { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #000; font: 400 16px/1.56 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-task input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0 12px; border: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,.09); border-radius: 6px; appearance: none; background: #fff; } .ds-task input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007aff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Completed Task Item
components.description: A completed task with green confirmation and receding copy.
components.css: .ds-task-complete { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 20px; color: rgba(60,60,67,.60); font: 400 16px/1.56 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-task-check { display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: 12px; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: #01bc4a; text-decoration: none; } .ds-task-check svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Quote Context
components.description: Metadata or quoted context structured by a quiet rule rather than a card.
components.html: 主题: 云同步与 AI 功能逻辑评审
components.css: .ds-quote { margin: 4px 0; padding: 0 0 0 18px; border-left: 2px solid rgba(115,121,140,.40); color: rgba(60,60,67,.60); font: 400 16px/1.56 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The document is the interface. Reading and editing occupy the same calm white canvas, with native controls appearing only when they are useful. Hierarchy comes from Chinese-first typography, compact vertical rhythm, and restrained semantic decoration rather than cards or extra chrome. The visual identity is editorial but not ornamental: ink remains dominant, secondary metadata recedes, and the only persistent color moments are the heading wash, system link blue, and task-completion green. Native iOS materials belong to controls; the note body remains flat and direct.
keyCharacteristics: One uninterrupted document surface for reading and editing.
Strong heading scale with more space above than below.
Sparse semantic color: lavender hierarchy, blue links, and green completion.
Native, compact controls with 44-point interaction targets.
Chinese typography, Dynamic Type, light/dark appearance, and reduced motion are first-class.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Color communicates hierarchy, action, or completion; it never becomes general decoration.

rules.name: The Full-Contrast Reading Rule
rules.body: Read-only content keeps the same foreground contrast as editable content.

rules.name: The Content-First Type Rule
rules.body: Weight and size establish hierarchy before color or container treatment.

rules.name: The Flat Document Rule
rules.body: Notes use spacing and type for structure; custom shadows and stacked surfaces stay out of the reading flow.

dos: Do keep reading and editing on the same rendered canvas.
Do preserve more space above a heading than below it.
Do reserve 44-point hit targets even when the visible glyph is smaller.
Do keep task state in exported Markdown and use lowercase [x] for completed items.
Do apply Dynamic Type, dark appearance, and Reduce Motion through native traits.
donts: Don't introduce a raw-source editor as a parallel visual mode.
Don't dim the whole note to communicate read-only state.
Don't add cards, decorative shadows, or extra toolbar commands to the core surface.
Don't use accent color where weight, spacing, or hierarchy already communicates the distinction.
Don't rely on CDN assets or browser-local storage for document state.
